findings.body: The API renders the configured contact address into version 1 on every read. Changing that address changes the text served under the same version, without publication of a new version or re-acceptance. The address saved on consent can also differ from the text the member read if configuration changes between reading and accepting. Store the fully rendered text as the published version.
findings.title: Not done: retain each notice version's exact published text

findings.body: This migration publishes version 1 immediately with `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`, including claims of a 3-day restore window and 7-day manual backup retention. The supplied change has no approval or purchased-plan verification gate before that publication. Keep the notice unpublished until its exact text is approved and those periods are checked.
findings.title: Not done: approve notice text and check backup periods before publication
